text: HOG: one trigger, h1_close_above:bar_high after a pull-in to the Creek (structure_shift_ref), timing WAIT. Imbalance up on all frames (W/D/H1 above EMA9, 9>21) but away from value, so I do not chase (C3, C15). reclaim:ma_20 enters on the reclaim close itself, buying the probe; ma_20 is not a value level on my test, and the entry must demand follow-through over the bar's high (C12). Livermore's 'buys the reaction' point lands on the same fault. Clears when the ticket carries that trigger. Wrong if a daily close under structure_shift_ref, or choch_bearish.
